decision: R21 grid is the continuing visual/layout baseline; fill the two unused cells with SLEW.
No home soldering; external standard parts acceptable when factory supplied/populated.
No hidden signal normals between modules, including S&H and noise.
Retain all existing 180 jack positions and 142 control positions; two new pots only.
No faders: all RISE/FALL are pots with separate stage LEDs.
Small capless continuous-pot family; OCT is a separately selected real six-position switch.
Buffered RC lag after capture, common amount for rise/fall; FAST not a mechanical bypass.
500 kΩ B504 +2.2 kΩ minimum +0.5 µF bank per SLEW channel, to be qualified before BOM release.
Flat panel plus height-compatible interface PCBs and rear core. Properly clamped jack bushings.
Reuse zudo-pd P/B with exact revision/configuration and an independent mounting pocket.
Use the official zudo-circuit-doc initializer/runtime; copy project material, not old lamp renderer code.
Scope10 and the OSC hole field are separate projects. Do not import scope circuitry into this synth.

Conditional nine-board partition: J, unified P, complete EL optical circuits, five stepped O adapters and distinct rear K at proposed z=-100mm; all438 UID centres retained. Exact sources and interface mapping in design/partition/partition.json.
